scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --ignore-pattern 'lint/fixtures/**' src lint scripts spec && oxfmt --check src lint scripts spec
scripts.format: oxlint --type-aware --fix --ignore-pattern 'lint/fixtures/**' src lint scripts spec && oxfmt --write src lint scripts spec
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run type-check && bun run test && bun run tlc
